label: prf:categorical-reeb-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical Reeb derivation
html:
Proof. Proof of uniqueness of the categorical Reeb derivation

By the vertical-generator axiom, \xi_i = \iota_{\xi_i} d\varTheta_A^{(i)} \circ (\pi_V \circ d)^{-1} on the vertical summand. Because T acts freely on A_V = \pi_V(A), the infinitesimal generator \xi_i is the unique lift of the T-action on A_V to an endomorphism of A — unique up to the Lie-algebra action of T, which is one-dimensional for T \cong U(1). The normalisation axiom \varTheta_A^{(i)}(\xi_i) = \mathrm{id}_{\mathbf{1}} fixes the remaining scalar, so \xi_1 = \xi_2. Given equal \xi, the dual form \varTheta_A^{(i)} is determined by the Maurer--Cartan condition and horizontality on \pi_H(A), forcing \varTheta_A^{(1)} = \varTheta_A^{(2)}.
